The '''Imperial Institute of Military Medicine''' was a medical organisation of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] that studied the advanced aging of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in [[8 BBY/Legends|8 BBY]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
